name: Halden Packaging credit policy
note: Halden Packaging is fictional; this policy is written for the Terms demo. Every desk decision must cite the clauses it relies on.

clauses.title: Limit ceiling
clauses.text: No customer limit above $2,000,000, and never above 1% of the customer's latest quarterly revenue as reported to the SEC.

clauses.title: Desk authority
clauses.text: The desk may lower limits, hold orders, and release orders within the available limit on its own. It may raise a limit by up to $250,000, to at most $1,000,000, on its own. Anything larger needs the credit manager's approval.

clauses.title: Severe delinquency
clauses.text: If any undisputed invoice is more than 60 days past due, hold every new order until that invoice is paid.

clauses.title: Loss-making customers
clauses.text: If net income was negative in two or more of the customer's last three reported quarters, the limit may not be increased.

clauses.title: Liquidity stress
clauses.text: A current ratio below 1.0 together with a loss in the latest quarter means new orders need prepayment, or the limit is cut by at least 25%.

clauses.title: Increase eligibility
clauses.text: A limit may rise by up to 25% when, over the last six months, the customer paid on average no more than 5 days late, utilisation is at least 80%, latest-quarter revenue is no more than 3% below the same quarter last year, the latest quarter was profitable, and no invoice is more than 30 days past due.

clauses.title: Disputes
clauses.text: Disputed amounts do not count as past due, but a dispute over $10,000 blocks any increase until it is resolved and must be named in the decision.

clauses.title: Early warning after an increase
clauses.text: If, within 30 days of an increase, the customer is past due on any invoice and uses more than 90% of the new limit, revert the increase and hold new orders until the account is current.

clauses.title: Evidence
clauses.text: Every decision cites the queries and clauses it relies on. A decision without evidence is not executed.

clauses.title: Order release
clauses.text: An order may be released only when open receivables plus the order fit within the effective limit and no hold applies.

clauses.title: Portfolio concentration
clauses.text: Limits on watch-list accounts (any POL-4 or POL-5 condition) may not exceed 30% of all credit limits.

sector_notes.title: Big-box retail runs negative working capital
sector_notes.text: Big-box general merchandise and grocery retailers collect from shoppers before they pay suppliers, so a current ratio below 1.0 is normal for them. On its own it is not a distress signal for this sector.

sector_notes.title: Acquired growth is not organic growth
sector_notes.text: When revenue jumps more than 25% year on year because of an acquisition, judge the combined company on its payment behaviour, and raise exposure in stages with the credit manager's approval.

sector_notes.title: Seasonal retail
sector_notes.text: Retail revenue peaks in the holiday quarter. Compare a quarter with the same quarter a year earlier, never with the quarter before.
